description: 국가철도공단 대구1호선 환승주차장 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 교통 승용차 운전자가 지하철이나 버스 따위의 다른 교통수단을 편리하게 이용하도록 하기 위하여 환승 시설 주변에 마련한 주차장을 말한다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 주차요금, 주차면수, 운영시간, 노선명, 역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
